behaviors.title: Atomic owned effect transitions and moving lighting composition
behaviors.scope: Owned candidate-copy atomic refusals for unsupported type/creator/kind/count/counter/dimensions, inconsistent positions/cache/terrain, corrupt/duplicate/missing chains, height exits, horizontal excursions, unsupported touched cells and later failures; moved source clears its old light location and illuminates its new location and composes with the existing headless lighting cycle; empty collision context is a caller precondition, not live world certification

behaviors.title: Remaining effect movement and lifecycle contracts
behaviors.scope: Selected effect movement, terrain occupancy, footprint lookup/initialization and bounded creature candidate snapshot/status filtering/raw coordinate production/first-hit collision integration are recovered separately. Kind34 creator selection for supported types is recovered separately; other types/nonzero metadata and termination, type35 terrain mutation, effect creation parents and installed trajectory inputs, creature descriptors and construction/lifecycle, installed catalogs/cells/columns and live scheduling remain unimplemented/unverified; combined branch coverage remains bounded by authored fixtures. The whole trajectory initializer is recovered separately from authored inputs.
